subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym for the underlined word in the given sentence.

His __ambition__ in life is to become a happy and satisfied man.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3** i.e. **Eagerness**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Ambition"** means a strong desire to achieve something, typically requiring determination and hard work. (महत्त्वाकांक्षा)

 
 
• **Example:** Her ambition to become a successful doctor kept her motivated through tough times.
 
 
 
• **Eagerness** refers to an intense desire or enthusiasm to do or achieve something. (उत्सुकता)
 
 
• **Example:** The students showed great eagerness to participate in the science fair.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Eagerness**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Apathy** (उदासीनता): Lack of interest, enthusiasm, or concern.

 
 
• **Example:** His apathy towards the project was evident in his lack of effort.
 
 
 
• **Satisfaction** (संतोष): A feeling of contentment or fulfillment.
 
 
• **Example:** Completing the marathon gave her immense satisfaction.
 
 
 
• **Amend** (संशोधन करना): To make changes or improvements to something.
 
 
• **Example:** The teacher advised him to amend his essay for better clarity.
